lines.text: The LORD says a man cannot hide in secret places, because He fills the heavens and the earth.
Lying prophets say they had a dream, hoping people forget His name as the people's fathers did through Chemosh.
The LORD says the prophet with a dream may retell it, and His word is like fire and a sword.
The LORD is against prophets who steal words from one another, and He did not send them.
The LORD says He will forsake them and punish whoever claims the burden of the LORD, with his household.
